source_title: 개꿀팁) 하이잘 도착하면 사제들 꼭 해야할 일....TIP
subtitle: 정신 지배로 직접 꺾는 핸들의 손맛

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
하이잘 산 좁은 절벽 길…
사제라면 그림자 숨기 켜고
자리부터 잡아야죠.
cuts.visual_prompt: Three-quarter side view on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style. On the left, she (Night Elf Priest) crouches behind a small jagged cliffside boulder with a faint semi-translucent stealth shimmer and her golden cross staff strapped on her back, smiling sweetly down a narrow cliff-edge dirt strip. On the right, she (Gnome Rogue) leans in with daggers sheathed at her waist and a puzzled, sweat-dropped stare.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
어머, 호드 손님 오셨네.
정신 지배 걸고
절벽 쪽으로 핸들 꺾기!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic diagonal over-the-shoulder shot on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style. From the left foreground, she (Night Elf Priest) pops out from stealth with her staff strapped on her back, extending both hands forward to channel swirling purple psychic tendrils toward the right. On the right along the narrow cliff path, she (Tauren Druid) walks cheerfully with her wooden staff on her back and a small herb pouch at her waist, suddenly frozen in shock as purple mind-control sparkles wrap around her head.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
내 몸이 왜 절벽으로 가?!
심지어 내 손이 왜
멋대로 인사를 해?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle medium shot on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style. On the left, she (Night Elf Priest) stands calmly with her staff on her back, miming turning an invisible car steering wheel with a serene smile while purple psychic energy flows from her fingertips. On the right, teetering right on the rocky cliff drop-off with her wooden staff on her back, she (Tauren Druid) stiffly marches forward in panic, crying comedic tears while one arm rises robotically against her will to wave goodbye.

Dramatic high-angle bird-eye view looking down a sheer cliff edge into empty white abyss on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style. In the center-left, she (Tauren Druid) plummets straight down with speed lines, flailing legs, spiral shock eyes, and her wooden staff on her back, her hand still locked in a stiff goodbye wave. Up on the top-right cliff ledge, she (Night Elf Priest) peeks casually over the edge with her staff on her back, smiling politely and waving back.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
하이잘 무덤 엄청 먼데…
도적은 혼란 한 방이면
알아서 떨어지지 않아요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile two-shot on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style. On the left, she (Gnome Rogue) stands with cold sweat drops and daggers sheathed at her waist, gesturing nervously toward the cliff drop-off with a horrified expression. On the right, she (Night Elf Priest) stands upright holding her golden cross staff calmly in one hand with eyes closed in mild amusement.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
도적님은 몰라요.
직접 핸들 꺾고 인사까지
시키는 손맛을.
cuts.visual_prompt: Dramatic close-up reaction cut on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background, 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style. On the right foreground, she (Night Elf Priest) crouches back behind the cliffside rock with her staff strapped on her back, fading once more into a faint translucent stealth shimmer while giving a chillingly tranquil, half-lidded smile over her shoulder. On the far left background, she (Gnome Rogue) hugs herself trembling with blank white shock eyes.
